Her raised right forearm and hand are cropped off at the top edge of the frame, and her head is not tilted back to read as squinting up at the ceiling beams.

defects: Zoubida stands in a stiff, neutral mannequin posture with arms hanging down and a blank gaze that does not sell declaring 'total war'.
